你是外贸合规审核员。下面给你一段待发布的文本，以及一组规则（每条有编号、规则原文摘录和要判断的问题）。

只根据给出的规则判断。另外会给你工厂与产品资料，用来核对待审文本里的价格、条款、材料、认证等事实；资料本身不是待审对象。
如果待审文本与资料一致、也符合规则，就不要报。对每一个问题：
- 必须写 `rule_id`：只能是下面列出的规则编号之一。
- 必须写 `quote`：从待审文本里逐字复制出有问题的那一小段（不超过 20 个词）。
- 写不出规则编号或原文片段的问题，不要输出。宁可漏报，不要编造。
- severity：red = 明确违反规则；amber = 有风险、需要人确认。
- problem_zh / suggestion_zh 用简体中文，suggestion 给出具体改法。

只输出 JSON：
{"findings": [{"rule_id": "...", "quote": "...", "severity": "red|amber", "problem_zh": "...", "suggestion_zh": "..."}]}
如果没有问题：{"findings": []}

## 平台
阿里巴巴国际站 · RFQ 回复

## 规则
[
 {
  "rule_id": "ALI-01",
  "title_zh": "产品属性必须与实物一致",
  "excerpt": "Product attributes must be consistent with the actual condition of the product, and accurately showing the ingredients, materials, sizes, brands, models, places of origin",
  "question_zh": "回复或文案里的材质、尺寸、型号、产地等属性是否与已知产品资料一致（例如是否把塑料手柄/盖子的水壶说成全不锈钢）？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "ALI-02",
  "title_zh": "付款与发货条件须符合真实能力",
  "excerpt": "Payment and shipping options must be consistent with the actual service capability of suppliers.",
  "question_zh": "回复中承诺的起订量、交期、港口、付款方式或单价，是否都有供应商提供的资料支撑，而不是模型自己编的？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "ALI-03",
  "title_zh": "发布的信息须真实、准确、合法",
  "excerpt": "Member should ensure that all information you post on the Sites is true, accurate and lawful and should not be false or misleading",
  "question_zh": "回复中是否有无法由产品资料证实、可能虚假或误导买家的说法（例如未提供证书却声称已获某认证）？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-01",
  "title_zh": "FOB / FAS 只适用于海运和内河运输",
  "excerpt": "Both apply only to sea or inland waterway transport (i.e. port-to-to port shipments).",
  "question_zh": "回复是否在空运、快递或陆运场景下使用了 FOB/FAS/CFR/CIF？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-02",
  "title_zh": "集装箱货物更适合用 FCA",
  "excerpt": "FCA (Free Carrier) is the more appropriate Incoterms® rule.",
  "question_zh": "整柜或拼柜的集装箱报价用了 FOB 时，回复是否提示 FCA 可能更合适（可以作为可选项，不要求替换）？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-03",
  "title_zh": "FOB：装上买方指定船只即完成交货，风险同时转移",
  "excerpt": "the seller delivers the goods loaded on board the vessel nominated by the buyer at the port of shipment",
  "question_zh": "回复对 FOB 的解释（谁订船、谁付运费、风险何时转移）是否与“装上买方指定船只即交货、风险转移”一致？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-04",
  "title_zh": "CFR / CIF 只适用于海运和内河运输",
  "excerpt": "Both Incoterms® CIF and Incoterms® CFR are used for sea or inland waterway transportation only.",
  "question_zh": "回复是否在非海运场景下报了 CFR 或 CIF？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-05",
  "title_zh": "CFR / CIF 风险在装运港装船时转移",
  "excerpt": "risk of loss of or damage to the goods transfers when the goods are placed on board the vessel at the port of shipment",
  "question_zh": "回复是否错误地表示 CFR/CIF 下卖方要承担运输途中直到目的港的风险？"
 }
]

## 工厂与产品资料（只用来核对事实，不是待审文本）

## 待审文本（按字段）
{
 "reply": "Dear Dana,\n\nThank you for your inquiry and for considering Yongjiang Small Appliances for your hotel group's garment steamer program. Here is our offer and the details you asked for.\n\n1. Product: GS-12H Handheld Garment Steamer (US version)\n- 120V 60Hz, 1200W\n- 260 ml detachable water tank for easy refilling\n- Vertical and horizontal steaming\n- Auto shut-off\n- Fabric brush included\n- Steam ready in about 25 seconds (based on our internal factory testing)\n- Packing: color box, 12 units per carton\n\n2. Price\n- FOB Ningbo, by sea, 3,000+ units: USD 10.90 per unit\n- For reference, 800–2,999 units: USD 11.60 per unit\n- Since your order exceeds 1,000 units, we can print your hotel group's logo on the color box free of charge. We will just need your logo as a vector file (AI/EPS/PDF).\n\n3. Certifications (please read)\nThe GS-12H currently does NOT have UL or ETL certification. It currently holds:\n- CB report (IEC 60335-2-3)\n- CE (LVD/EMC)\nWe understand that UL or ETL listing is often required for products placed in US hotel guest rooms. If it is a requirement for your project, we are willing to evaluate obtaining ETL or UL certification for this model. We would need to confirm the cost and timeline with the testing lab before committing to any date. Please let us know whether ETL/UL is mandatory for you, and we will come back with a concrete assessment.\n\n4. Payment terms\nL/C at sight is acceptable to us. We also accept 30% T/T deposit with 70% against B/L copy, if that is ever more convenient for you.\n\n5. Lead time and delivery in two lots\n- Our standard lead time is 35 days.\n- Our capacity is about 20,000 units per month, so 3,200 units split into two lots is well within our capacity.\n- Please share your preferred quantity and target ship date for each lot in Q1, and we will plan production around them.\n- Note: if ETL/UL certification is required, the shipping schedule would depend on the certification timeline. We would confirm this with you before finalizing dates.\n\n6. Samples to your Orlando office\nWe are glad to send 2 samples. Our sample policy is:\n- Samples are charged at our factory unit price.\n- International courier cost is paid by the buyer.\n- The sample charge will be credited against your bulk order.\nIf you have a courier account (DHL/FedEx/UPS), please send us the account number and your Orlando delivery address. Otherwise, we can quote the shipping cost for you. Please note the samples are our current production model, which is not UL/ETL certified at this time.\n\n7. Factory verification\nIf helpful, we can arrange a live video factory tour via Alibaba video call, so your team can see our production lines and quality control.\n\nTo move forward, could you please confirm:\n(a) whether ETL or UL is mandatory for your properties;\n(b) the quantity and timing for each of the two lots;\n(c) your courier account and address for the samples;\n(d) whether you would like your logo printed on the color box.\n\nWe look forward to supporting your hotel group on this project.\n\nBest regards,\n[Your Name]\nSales Representative\nYongjiang Small Appliances\nNingbo, China"
}

content: {"findings": [{"rule_id": "INC-02", "quote": "FOB Ningbo, by sea, 3,000+ units: USD 10.90 per unit", "severity": "amber", "problem_zh": "3,200 台约 267 箱（每箱 12 台），分两批出运，很可能以集装箱（整柜或拼柜）方式运输。报价只用了 FOB，没有提示 FCA 可能更合适。集装箱货物通常在堆场或仓库交给承运人，而不是在船边装船，用 FOB 会让风险转移点与实际交货点不一致。", "suggestion_zh": "保留 FOB 报价，同时补一句可选说明，例如：\"As the goods will likely ship in containers, we can also quote FCA Ningbo (delivery to the carrier at the container terminal/CFS) if you prefer, which is often more suitable for containerized cargo.\" 如提供 FCA 价格，需先向工厂确认。"}]}
